modifications: Upstream source files are unchanged. The local launcher disables arbitrary external applications in the product and installs a seccomp filter. Local notebook versioning uses a separate helper restricted to fixed Git subcommands and exchange paths; Git hooks, network protocols and further program execution are disabled.
configuration: English baseline, supplied X11/D-Bus/AT-SPI session, all product state and configuration under DATA_DIR; the notebook is the folder PBP_NOTEBOOK (DATA_DIR/notebook when unset); foreground exec of the unmodified upstream zim.py (a GUI on the notebook without arguments, the upstream command line with arguments). The reference interpreter cannot execute programs; custom tools and external-application plugins cannot start commands. A separate validated helper preserves local notebook Git history without permitting external hooks or network access.
